reply.text: Sounds like that last interval took everything out of you. Before I read anything into it, I want to check your recent running so I can see what the week looked like going into it. Nothing from the last two weeks is logged, so I can't tell from the record how the lead-up went. If you tell me what the interval session was, how long the work and rest intervals were, and how you'd slept and eaten that day, I can help you sort out whether it was pacing, the effort, or just a rough day. And if you feel dizzy, chest pain, or anything else that worries you beyond ordinary breathlessness, get it checked by a doctor before the next session.
